# Mitchell Telfer

**Role:** Mark's eldest son
**Born:** 28 May 2008

---

|----------|------|

| **Father** | [[Mark Kenneth Telfer (1986–?)]] |

---

## Life Summary

Mitchell was diagnosed with **Ohdo Syndrome**, a rare genetic disorder. He is non-verbal and requires full-time care. He lives in Victoria with his mother's family.

---

## Stories & Memories

Mark fought for and maintained supervised access visits throughout 2013, bringing toys and providing high-standard care under difficult conditions.
